title: security: rbac v2 - enforce KMS region pinning & audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning policy for RBAC v2 and enhance audit logging for data residency decisions. No public API changes.
description:
Context: Customers in regulated regions have asked for stronger controls to prevent cross-region KMS usage and to get deterministic audit trails for key residency decisions. This PR closes gaps in RBAC v2 enforcement where region pinning was previously advisory-only and augments audit logging to include KMS key ARN, region, and decision reason.

What this PR does: Implements hard enforcement of KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies, surfaces additional audit fields, adds unit and integration tests, and updates docs and Helm manifests for Private deployments. Changes are scoped to internal policy evaluation and audit services; no external API surface changes.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement enforcement in policy engine (services/rbac-v2)
- [x] Add audit fields (services/audit) and wire through to audit-log-exporter
- [x] Integration + unit tests covering edge cases (cross-account keys, missing region metadata)
- [x] Update docs and deployment templates for Private (Helm)
- [x] Run security scan and fix flagged policy edge-case
- [x] Add Linear/Jira links and update changelog

Risk: Medium — enforcement changes model behavior for RBAC policies referencing KMS keys in mismatched regions. Added a toggle flag (rbac.v2.enforce_kms_region_pinning) defaulted to true for new installs; existing Dedicated/Private clusters will be rolled out with a migration plan.

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind a config flag. Will ship with canary in Dedicated and Private, monitor audit events, and coordinate with Solutions/Customer Success for large customers with custom KMS setups.
change_summary: Add enforcement for KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 pipeline, emit richer audit entries (kms_key_arn, kms_region, decision_reason), add unit+integration tests, update docs and Helm templates, and bump policy schema version.
commits_summary: 3 commits: (1) enforce KMS region pinning in policy evaluator; (2) enrich audit payloads and wire through audit-exporter; (3) tests, docs, CI fixes and changelog entry.
diff_snippets:
services/audit/handlers/audit_log.go: // enrich audit with kms metadata
auditEntry.Metadata["kms_key_arn"] = req.KMSKeyARN
auditEntry.Metadata["kms_region"] = extractRegion(req.KMSKeyARN)
auditEntry.Metadata["decision_reason"] = decision.Reason
tests/integration/test_kms_region_pinning.go: assert.False(evaluatePolicy(...)) // cross-region key should be denied when enforce flag is true
